description: Implementation of the HostResolverMdnsTask class for handling mDNS hostname resolution, including transaction management, result parsing, and completion handling within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::Transaction
classes.description: Handles individual mDNS query transactions, manages their lifecycle, and processes completion callbacks.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::Transaction::Start
methods.description: Initiates the mDNS transaction and sets up callback for completion.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::Transaction::IsDone
methods.description: Checks if the transaction has completed.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::Transaction::IsError
methods.description: Checks if the transaction resulted in an error.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::ParseResult
methods.description: Parses the DNS record result into a HostCache::Entry.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::CheckCompletion
methods.description: Checks if all transactions are complete or if any have errors, then triggers completion.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::Complete
methods.description: Finalizes the task, cancels incomplete transactions, and runs the completion callback.
